one_liner_zh: 賽默飛世爾EPS超預期、營收年增6.18%，生命科學需求回穩。
one_liner_en: Thermo Fisher beat EPS with 6.18% revenue growth, as life-science demand stabilized.
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：EPS超標與6.18%營收年增顯示生命科學需求自前期庫存調整中回穩，多元化組合提供韌性。短中期股價有獲利回升與穩定現金流支撐，25.97倍本益比合理偏中性。中期關鍵在生技資本支出與藥廠外包需求。追蹤指標：有機營收成長、耗材與儀器量能、製藥服務（CRO／CDMO）訂單、調整後營業利潤率，以及全年EPS指引與回購節奏。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: an EPS beat and 6.18% revenue growth show life-science demand stabilizing after prior destocking, with the diversified portfolio providing resilience. Near to mid-term, the stock is supported by recovering earnings and steady cash flow, with a reasonable-to-neutral 25.97x P/E. Mid-term, biotech capex and pharma outsourcing demand are key. Track: organic revenue growth, consumables and instrument volumes, pharma-services (CRO/CDMO) bookings, adjusted operating margin, and full-year EPS guidance plus buyback cadence.
highlights_zh: EPS 5.44美元，超越預期5.24美元，正向驚喜3.79%
營收110.1億美元，年增6.18%顯示需求回穩
多元化儀器、耗材與CRO服務組合分散風險
生技製藥研發與生產外包需求支撐長期成長
highlights_en: EPS of $5.44 beat the $5.24 estimate, a 3.79% positive surprise
Revenue of $11.01B grew 6.18%, indicating demand stabilization
Diversified instruments, consumables, and CRO services spread risk
Biopharma R&D and outsourced manufacturing demand support long-term growth
risks_zh: 生技與學術研究經費波動影響儀器與耗材需求
本益比25.97在成長溫和下評價偏滿
併購整合與商譽減損潛在風險
risks_en: Volatile biotech and academic research funding affects instrument and consumable demand
A 25.97x P/E looks full given moderate growth
Potential M&A integration and goodwill-impairment risk
